title: Walkthroughs on GitHub Pages
lede: Merged walkthroughs become readable in a browser, without cloning: the existing Pages deploy now copies them next to the app, at `walkthroughs/<name>.html`.

files.question: When do walkthroughs reach the site?
files.summary: One step in `check`, after the build and before the Pages upload, on `main` only.
files.never: Builds or checks walkthroughs; the existing gate still does that.
files.tested: Not run yet: the step runs only on a push to `main`, so the first merge is its test.

steps.title: push to main: build, copy, upload
steps.explain: The app is built into `dist`, then the walkthroughs are copied in, so one Pages artifact holds both. The pages inline everything they need, so a plain copy is enough. The copy skips pull requests, like the upload it feeds: PR runs never deploy. Not run yet: the first push to `main` after this merge will prove it.

run.from: - name: Add walkthroughs to the site

notes.title: Only merged walkthroughs are published
notes.detail: PR walkthroughs still open through the `git show` command in the PR body. Publishing per-PR previews would need a second deploy target, which isn't worth it for this project.

omitted.docs/agents/pr-walkthrough.md: One sentence: the published URL to use for links that outlive the PR.
